<!--
PR title must follow Conventional Commits, e.g. "fix(chat): keep draft after reconnect".
It becomes the squash commit on main. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What is wrong or missing? Include expected behaviour and how to reproduce. -->

## Change

<!-- How does this fix it? Keep it to one underlying problem. -->

## Related issue / discussion

<!-- Closes #123, or link the Ideas discussion for features. -->

## Verification

<!-- What did you run or check, and what did you observe?
"Tests pass" alone is not enough. For UI changes add before/after screenshots
or a short recording (upload to GitHub, do not commit them). State anything you could not check. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated (if behaviour changed)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or personal data included

<!-- If an AI agent did substantial work, end with the model and tool used. -->
